subject: Reconciliation: API availability windows on 2026-07-30 — compensation proposal

Subject: Intermittent availability on 2026-07-30 — request for remediation and credits

Hi Soojin,

We saw a 30–40% increase in 5xxs and a series of 6 distinct ~30s availability windows between 02:15–05:20 UTC on 2026-07-30 that materially impacted our inference jobs and caused failed job retries across our batch pipelines. Our SREs collected traces and a PCAP; attaching the summary.

Customer impact: several production endpoints experienced request timeouts; throughput dropped ~45% for the windows noted. We spent engineering cycles rerouting and patching retries. Lossless would like to understand: 1) root cause, 2) a concrete mitigation timeline, and 3) what goodwill compensation or trial extension you can offer while we assess the risk of continuing to ramp.

Attachments: incident_pcap.log (trimmed), usage_report_20260730.csv

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement and a proposed remediation/credit offer.

Thanks,
Tom

Head of Platform Engineering, Lossless AI

Subject: Fwd: Intermittent availability on 2026-07-30 — internal calc request

Marissa / Dev — forwarding Lossless report. Quick ask: can we approve a token credit and 30-day trial extension pending final RCA? Draft calc below, please review and flag any objections.

Draft credit calc (preliminary):
- Affected window: ~3.1 hours total in UTC across the day
- Estimated impacted tokens (based on Lossless usage report): 1.2M tokens
- Typical unit price (hosted): $0.0007/token -> estimated $840
- Goodwill uplift (to recognize engineering & customer ops time): add 25% -> $1,050 equivalent in token credit
- Alternate offer: 50k free API credits + 30-day trial extension + SRE postmortem call

Questions for approval:
- Is $1,050 (or token equivalent) acceptable as an interim?
- Any regulatory/compliance sign-off needed for the trial extension?
- Who should own the DocuSign/acceptance flow?

Thanks — trying to keep this low friction.

Thanks Soojin — reviewed. Approve the interim $1,050 credit equivalent as token top-up and the 30-day trial extension for Lossless AI, with the following conditions:

- Credit to be applied to their account immediately after they acknowledge the offer in HubSpot.
- Trial extension limited to the org and non-transferable; mark account with remediation note for 12 months.
- Require SRE postmortem within 7 business days; if root cause extends to multi-tenant runtime bug attributable to Redwood, consider additional credit after RCA.

Dev — please prioritise the RCA & patch schedule; include mitigations for kernel-level eviction detection + automated fallback testing.

Marissa
